@@ -989,6 +991,18 @@ def _rms_norm_aten_compat(input, normalized_shape, weight=None, eps=None):
 
 
 def _mm_dtype_compat(self, mat2, out_dtype):
+    if (
+        out_dtype == torch.float32
+        and self.dtype in (torch.float16, torch.bfloat16)
+        and mat2.dtype == self.dtype
+        and mat2.transpose(0, 1).is_contiguous()
+    ):
+        # The previous contiguous transpose selected this same Triton kernel,
+        # but copied the entire vocabulary weight matrix on every forward.
+        # Its explicit strides support this column-major view directly.
+        return _matmul_persistent_triton(
